text: ウチの　ヤドン　なにやら　ふにゃふにゃ　いってたな…　ボケた　のか？

structure.jp: なにやら　ふにゃふにゃ　いってたな…

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ていた says something was going on in the past; てた is the short spoken form. いってた = 'was saying'.

patterns.name: 〜のか
patterns.explanation: のか at the end asks for the explanation behind what you noticed, often half to yourself. ボケた　のか = 'is it that he's gone senile?'.
